Level Down!.text: Reveal 1 "LV" monster in your hand, and reduce its Level by 2 until the End Phase.
Level Down!.implementation_note: Project Ignis maintains Level Down! separately from official TCG Level Down!? (90500169). Reviewed for the Reborn pool because the pool explicitly contains Level Down!.

policy: Nonstandard records are allowed only for exact Reborn pool cards with independently reviewed identity/behavior evidence. They must never be substituted for a different TCG card merely because the name is similar.
